== Strategy ==

This is a straight LSC deck. The only downfalls come from lack of cards. I do not have another Emperor Palpatine or Lord Maul, otherwise this deck would be slightly different. Most of my cards are intended as high destiny for combat cards. However, if needs be I can use them as well. The space group is for simple defense in case of Battle Plan. Beyond all of this, its a combat or battle deck on Theed. Thanks for reading!
